data.long_description:
Located in the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club – The Residences, this elegant 4-bedroom villa offers a refined blend of luxury living and equestrian lifestyle within a serene, resort-style community.

Property Details:

4 Spacious Bedrooms
5 Modern Bathrooms
Unfurnished 
Open-plan living and dining area
Fully fitted modern / Italian-style kitchen
Maid’s room + storage areas
Private landscaped garden
Covered parking

Key Features:

Floor-to-ceiling windows allowing abundant natural light
Contemporary interiors with high-end finishes
Large balconies overlooking lush greenery / polo fields
Bright and airy layout designed for family living

Community Highlights:

Exclusive gated community with 24/7 security
Access to world-class polo and equestrian facilities
Four international polo fields & riding academy
Swimming pools, gym, tennis courts & spa
Fine dining restaurants, lounges & retail outlets
Peaceful, resort-style environment with landscaped surroundings

Lifestyle:
Experience a unique polo-inspired lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most distinctive communities, combining luxury, privacy, and leisure. Ideal for families seeking tranquility while remaining well-connected to key areas of the city.
